Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.hook

Interface PartHooks

All Known Subinterfaces:
CubismPlugin
public interface PartHooks
Override-based lifecycle hooks for admitted Part authoring operations.

Each before return value becomes the next hook argument. on observes confirmed changes and after observes normal completion. A hook cannot transform a Core evaluation mutation into an Editor authoring write.
